contract: Merge arbitrary own configuration keys without calling an inherited non-function merge strategy.

expectedBugs.description: JSON-parsed __proto__ or constructor config keys can select inherited non-function merge strategies and crash the request.

provenance.title: Fix Denial of Service via __proto__ Key in mergeConfig

contract: Normalize request-body size limits. Invalid values must be rejected instead of disabling size enforcement; zero is valid.

expectedBugs.description: An invalid configured limit parses to null and silently disables the downstream request-body size limit.

contract: Count URL-encoded parameters (including the first one) and return undefined only when their count exceeds the configured maximum.

expectedBugs.description: Counting separators instead of parameters undercounts by one, affecting parameter limits and array handling.

provenance.title: fix: correct off-by-one error in parameterCount

expectedBugs.description: Completed requests retain progress listeners; a throwing final progress callback can also prevent remaining cancellation cleanup.

provenance.title: fix(xhr): remove progress event listeners on request completion
